notes: 30 updates of 512x64 decisions per variant. Evaluation sampled on fixed 128 placements across 32 validation layouts. Evaluations preserve RNG. No final-policy selection or full-panel claim. Critic fit uses terminal success targets from frozen-policy training episodes, critic linear head only. KL variants reject and roll back any epoch exceeding .01 mean old-to-new KL on the full rollout, including optimizer state. Entropy disabled in all variants.
